column1: Fig. S7 Changes in litter quality during the dry season 2012. The left, middle and right column of panels present the results for *Avena*, *Calicotome* and *Scabiosa* litter, respectively. Litter nitrogen (N) and lignin concentrations were presented on an ash-free, dry-mass basis. * significant difference among means at the end of the dry season within a litter type at P ≤ 0.05 (Tukey–Kramer HSD test). “No-sc.”, “Tr.” and “R.bl.” are used to indicate significant differences between the no-screen, transparent and radiation-block treatments, respectively. Mean ± SE. Note the different scales on the y-axis for N concentration and C:N ratio of the three species.*n* = 5.
